user.title: Budget Thuis
user.description: Budget Thuis logs you in with an e-mailed login link. Enter the e-mail address of your account and a link will be sent to it. Your contract is detected automatically.

data_description.username: The email address you use to sign in to the Budget Thuis app or website.

select_contract.title: Select contract
select_contract.description: Choose the contract to add. Optionally give it a custom name.

data_description.contract_id: The energy contract these sensors will report on.
data_description.name: Shown as the device name and used in entity IDs. Defaults to a neutral name; the address is never used.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Budget Thuis
reauth_confirm.description: Your Budget Thuis session has expired. Submit to send a new login link to {username}.

link.title: Paste the login link
link.description: A login link was sent to {username}. Do NOT click it: right-click (or long-press) the login button in the e-mail, copy the link address and paste it below. The link can be used only once and expires after a short time.

data_description.login_link: The full link from the Budget Thuis e-mail. It is used once to log in and is never stored.

error.invalid_auth: Login was refused by Budget Thuis.
error.no_contracts: No contracts found on this account.
error.invalid_email: Budget Thuis did not accept this e-mail address.
error.invalid_link: This login link is invalid, expired or already used. Go back and request a new link.

abort.reauth_account_mismatch: This account does not have access to the configured contract. Re-authenticate with the original account.

data_description.update_interval: How often to fetch new prices, in minutes (5–360).
data_description.price_type: Whether price sensors report gross (including VAT) or net (excluding VAT) prices.
